about: Built on CalcpadCE 8.0.0-beta3-preview (MIT), by Nedelcho Ganchovski (Proektsoft) and contributors. The engine is reimplemented in Rust and runs in your browser.
MIT licence. Not affiliated with the CalcpadCE authors.
shortcuts: Ctrl+F find, Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z redo
F2 rename the name under the cursor everywhere in the document
Ctrl+; find a variable or function (Enter inserts it, Alt+Enter goes to its definition)
F12 go to the definition, Shift+F12 find references
Ctrl+Shift+/ disable or enable the block at the cursor
settings: How results and input boxes show numbers. The worksheet itself always uses a decimal point, so files stay the same wherever they are opened.
In an input box with a decimal comma, both 6,5 and 6.5 are accepted. Plots, code listings and spreadsheet-style grids keep the decimal point.
@title=Professional (checked) renders equations in stacked math form; Inline (unchecked) renders them on a single line.
@title=Display very small matrix/vector values as 0 instead of using scientific notation.
@title=Ignore #hide so suppressed content is rendered anyway. For debugging.
@title=Maximum number of rows/columns shown for large matrices and vectors (5-100).
@title=Relative precision for numerical methods such as integration and root finding (1e-15 to 1e-2). Can be overridden per-document with a Precision = … line.
@title=Target tolerance for the iterative PCG solver and eigensolver (1e-15 to 1e-2). Can be overridden per-document with a Tol = … line.
@title=Concentrates sample points where the curve bends sharply instead of spacing them evenly. Produces smoother plots of curved functions at a lower point count; disable for a fixed dense sampling.
@title=Renders plots as SVG (scalable, sharp at any zoom) instead of raster PNG images.
@title=Width of the plot area in pixels (at least 1). Can be overridden per-document with a PlotWidth = … line.
@title=Height of the plot area in pixels (at least 1). Can be overridden per-document with a PlotHeight = … line.
@title=Mesh size for map (surface) plotting in pixels; 0 lets Calcpad choose automatically. Can be overridden per-document with a PlotStep = … line.
@title=Selects US or UK definitions for bare unit names that differ between the two systems (gal, ton, cwt, pt, qt, bbl, tonf, therm, etc.).
@title=Top page margin - a length with a unit, e.g. 2cm, 0.5in, or 12mm
@title=Bottom page margin - a length with a unit, e.g. 2cm, 0.5in, or 12mm
@title=Left page margin - a length with a unit, e.g. 2cm, 0.5in, or 12mm
@title=Right page margin - a length with a unit, e.g. 2cm, 0.5in, or 12mm
@title=Show "Page n of m" in the footer
@title=.NET date/time format string, e.g. M/d/yyyy h:mm tt
@title=Header/footer separator line color as a hex code, default #b3b3b3
@title=Ctrl+B for bold, Ctrl+I for italic, etc.
@title=Scroll the preview to follow the line the cursor is on in the editor.
@title=When off, the preview only re-renders when it is first opened or a manual run is triggered.

@title=Preview normally shows the document's own values. Turn this on to render it with the values entered into the input form instead, for tracking down an error that only appears once a form is filled in.
@title=Opens the folder containing server logs and the most recent crash dump.
@title=Failures plus recoverable problems, such as a missing browser for PDF export. The default, and silent during normal editing.
@title=Lines retained in each Output channel before older lines are dropped. Lower values reduce memory use and improve responsiveness when logs are noisy.

@title=A worksheet that renders to more HTML than this is not shown in the preview - showing it risks running the app out of memory. Exporting to PDF, HTML or DOCX is unaffected. Raise it only if you need very large documents on screen.

@title=How many console lines one preview render may relay before the rest are dropped. A worksheet whose scripts log in a loop can otherwise flood the console channel. Raise it when debugging a script, lower it when a library is noisy. Each line is clipped to 4 KB regardless.
Worksheet scripts may load only these files, each from its exact address and checked against its hash. Anything else is blocked and the preview names it.
